AI BIJAN Motion - packed source files of this folder. Do not edit by hand.
The skill upload in the Claude app accepts at most 200 files, so the source files are packed here.
`node <skill folder>/new-project.mjs <project folder> --kit=<style>` unpacks them into the project.
Format: per file one line with four '=' signs, the byte length and the path, then exactly that many bytes.

==== 24878 project/scripts/synth.ts
// CHARACTERFLOW sound kit: a tiny deterministic synthesiser (no samples, no third-party audio).
// Buses, filters, oscillators, instruments, foley generators, reverb and a VO-ducking mixer.
// Topic scores (scripts/sound.ts) place these on the film clock.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";

export const SR = 48000;
export const S = (t: number) => Math.round(t * SR);

export const rng = (seed: number) => () => {
  seed |= 0;
  seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  let x = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
  x = (x + Math.imul(x ^ (x >>> 7), 61 | x)) ^ x;
  return ((x ^ (x >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
export const clamp = (x: number, a: number, b: number) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x));
export const smooth = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const k = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return k * k * (3 - 2 * k); };
export const dbg = (db: number) => 10 ** (db / 20);
const mtof = (m: number) => 440 * 2 ** ((m - 69) / 12);
const NOTE: Record<string, number> = { C: 0, "C#": 1, Db: 1, D: 2, "D#": 3, Eb: 3, E: 4, F: 5, "F#": 6, Gb: 6, G: 7, "G#": 8, Ab: 8, A: 9, "A#": 10, Bb: 10, B: 11 };
export const nf = (n: string) => { const m = /^([A-G][#b]?)(-?\d)$/.exec(n)!; return mtof(12 * (Number(m[2]) + 1) + NOTE[m[1]]); };

export class Bus {
  L: Float32Array; R: Float32Array; N: number;
  constructor(N: number) { this.N = N; this.L = new Float32Array(N); this.R = new Float32Array(N); }
  /** add a mono signal at time t (s), equal-power pan −1..1 */
  add(t: number, x: Float32Array, gain = 1, pan = 0) {
    const o = S(t);
    const gl = Math.cos(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4) * gain * Math.SQRT2, gr = Math.sin(((pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4) * gain * Math.SQRT2;
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const j = o + i; if (j < 0 || j >= this.N) continue; this.L[j] += x[i] * gl; this.R[j] += x[i] * gr; }
  }
  addSt(t: number, l: Float32Array, r: Float32Array, gain = 1) {
    const o = S(t);
    for (let i = 0; i < l.length; i++) { const j = o + i; if (j < 0 || j >= this.N) continue; this.L[j] += l[i] * gain; this.R[j] += r[i] * gain; }
  }
}

/** RBJ biquad, in place. `f` may vary per sample. */
export const biquad = (x: Float32Array, type: "lp" | "hp" | "bp" | "peak", f: number | ((i: number) => number), q = 0.707, gainDb = 0) => {
  let x1 = 0, x2 = 0, y1 = 0, y2 = 0, b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, a1 = 0, a2 = 0, lastF = -1;
  const coef = (fc: number) => {
    const w = (2 * Math.PI * clamp(fc, 10, SR * 0.45)) / SR, cw = Math.cos(w), sw = Math.sin(w), al = sw / (2 * q);
    let a0: number;
    if (type === "lp") { b0 = (1 - cw) / 2; b1 = 1 - cw; b2 = b0; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else if (type === "hp") { b0 = (1 + cw) / 2; b1 = -(1 + cw); b2 = b0; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else if (type === "bp") { b0 = al; b1 = 0; b2 = -al; a0 = 1 + al; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al; }
    else { const A = 10 ** (gainDb / 40); b0 = 1 + al * A; b1 = -2 * cw; b2 = 1 - al * A; a0 = 1 + al / A; a1 = -2 * cw; a2 = 1 - al / A; }
    b0 /= a0; b1 /= a0; b2 /= a0; a1 /= a0; a2 /= a0;
  };
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) {
    const fc = typeof f === "number" ? f : f(i);
    if (typeof f !== "number" ? (i & 31) === 0 : lastF < 0) { coef(fc); lastF = fc; }
    const y = b0 * x[i] + b1 * x1 + b2 * x2 - a1 * y1 - a2 * y2;
    x2 = x1; x1 = x[i]; y2 = y1; y1 = y;
    x[i] = y;
  }
  return x;
};

export const noise = (n: number, seed = 1) => { const r = rng(seed); const a = new Float32Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a[i] = r() * 2 - 1; return a; };
export const pink = (n: number, seed = 1) => {
  const w = noise(n, seed); let b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { b0 = 0.99765 * b0 + w[i] * 0.099046; b1 = 0.963 * b1 + w[i] * 0.2965164; b2 = 0.57 * b2 + w[i] * 1.0526913; w[i] = (b0 + b1 + b2 + w[i] * 0.1848) * 0.2; }
  return w;
};
export const envExp = (x: Float32Array, tau: number, attack = 0.002) => { for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const t = i / SR; x[i] *= Math.min(1, t / attack) * Math.exp(-t / tau); } return x; };
export const envAR = (x: Float32Array, a: number, r: number) => { const d = x.length / SR; for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) { const t = i / SR; x[i] *= smooth(0, a, t) * (1 - smooth(d - r, d, t)); } return x; };
export const sine = (dur: number, f: number | ((t: number) => number), phase = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), a = new Float32Array(n); let p = phase;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const fr = typeof f === "number" ? f : f(i / SR); p += (2 * Math.PI * fr) / SR; a[i] = Math.sin(p); }
  return a;
};
export const saw = (dur: number, f: number, seed = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), a = new Float32Array(n); let p = rng(seed)();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { p += f / SR; p -= Math.floor(p); a[i] = 2 * p - 1; }
  return a;
};
export const mixInto = (dst: Float32Array, src: Float32Array, g = 1) => { for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(dst.length, src.length); i++) dst[i] += src[i] * g; return dst; };

// ── instruments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export type Out = { dry: Bus; verb: Bus };

/** Warm pad: 3 detuned saws per note → 2-pole low-pass, slow envelope. */
export const pad = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, notes: string[], g: number, cutoff = 900, a = 1.5, r = 1.5, pan = 0, bright = 0) => {
  const dur = t1 - t0, n = S(dur);
  const L = new Float32Array(n), R = new Float32Array(n);
  notes.forEach((nn, k) => {
    const f = nf(nn);
    for (const [d, p] of [[-0.006, -0.6], [0, 0], [0.007, 0.6]] as const) {
      const s = saw(dur, f * (1 + d), k * 7 + Math.round(d * 1000));
      const gl = Math.cos(((p * 0.7 + pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4), gr = Math.sin(((p * 0.7 + pan + 1) * Math.PI) / 4);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { L[i] += s[i] * gl; R[i] += s[i] * gr; }
    }
  });
  const fc = (i: number) => cutoff * (1 + bright * smooth(0, n, i));
  biquad(L, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(L, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(R, "lp", fc, 0.6); biquad(R, "lp", fc, 0.6);
  envAR(L, a, r); envAR(R, a, r);
  const k = g / Math.max(1, notes.length * 1.2);
  o.dry.addSt(t0, L, R, k);
  o.verb.addSt(t0, L, R, k * 0.5);
};

export const pluck = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, pan = 0, decay = 0.996, brightness = 0.5) => {
  const f = nf(note), p = Math.max(2, Math.round(SR / f));
  const n = S(2.2), y = new Float32Array(n), buf = noise(p, Math.round(t * 1000 + f));
  biquad(buf, "lp", 1500 + brightness * 5000);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const j = i % p; const v = buf[j]; buf[j] = decay * 0.5 * (v + buf[(j + 1) % p]); y[i] = v; }
  envExp(y, 0.9, 0.002);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.5, pan);
};

export const bell = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, dur = 3, pan = 0) => {
  const f = nf(note), n = S(dur), y = new Float32Array(n);
  for (const [m, a, tau] of [[1, 1, 1.4], [2.76, 0.45, 0.7], [5.4, 0.25, 0.35], [8.93, 0.12, 0.2]] as const) mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * m), tau * (dur / 3), 0.002), a);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g * 0.3, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.35, pan);
};

export const kalimba = (o: Out, t: number, note: string, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const f = nf(note), y = envExp(sine(1.8, f), 0.55, 0.002);
  mixInto(y, envExp(sine(1.8, f * 5.4), 0.06, 0.001), 0.25);
  mixInto(y, envExp(sine(1.8, f * 2), 0.25, 0.002), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, y, g * 0.35, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, y, g * 0.3, pan);
};

/** Electric-piano chord (sine partials + tremolo). */
export const ep = (o: Out, t: number, notes: string[], g: number, dur: number) => {
  notes.forEach((nn, k) => {
    const f = nf(nn), y = envExp(sine(dur, f), dur * 0.45, 0.01);
    mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * 2), dur * 0.18, 0.005), 0.25);
    mixInto(y, envExp(sine(dur, f * 3), dur * 0.08, 0.003), 0.08);
    for (let i = 0; i < y.length; i++) y[i] *= 1 + 0.12 * Math.sin((2 * Math.PI * 4.5 * i) / SR);
    envAR(y, 0.01, 0.4);
    o.dry.add(t + k * 0.014, y, (g * 0.3) / notes.length, (k / Math.max(1, notes.length - 1) - 0.5) * 0.5);
    o.verb.add(t, y, (g * 0.25) / notes.length);
  });
};

export const subPulse = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f0 = 55) => { const x = envExp(sine(0.6, (u) => f0 - 18 * Math.min(1, u * 5)), 0.12, 0.004); o.dry.add(t, x, g); };

// ── foley / design ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
export const click = (o: Out, t: number, f: number, g: number, pan = 0, tau = 0.012) => {
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.08), Math.round(t * 997)), "bp", f, 2.5), tau * 0.5, 0.0005);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.08, f * 0.62), tau, 0.0005), 0.4);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.15, pan);
};
export const thud = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f = 60, tau = 0.18, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(sine(0.8, (u) => f * (1.25 - 0.3 * Math.min(1, u * 4))), tau, 0.002);
  mixInto(x, envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.8), Math.round(t * 31)), "lp", 500), tau * 0.4, 0.002), 0.6);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.3, pan);
};
/** Fabric: band-passed noise with a slow, uneven swell. */
export const rustle = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0, f = 2400) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 113)), "bp", f, 0.7), "hp", 700);
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 71));
  let e = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / n;
    if ((i & 255) === 0) e = 0.55 + 0.45 * r();
    x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * e;
  }
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.12, pan);
};
export const whoosh = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, f0: number, f1: number, pan0 = -0.4, pan1 = 0.4) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 71)), "bp", (i) => f0 * (f1 / f0) ** (i / n), 1.2);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / n; x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * u) ** 1.5; }
  const L = new Float32Array(n), R = new Float32Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = pan0 + (pan1 - pan0) * (i / n); L[i] = x[i] * Math.cos(((p + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); R[i] = x[i] * Math.sin(((p + 1) * Math.PI) / 4); }
  o.dry.addSt(t, L, R, g);
  o.verb.addSt(t, L, R, g * 0.3);
};
export const heartbeat = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => {
  for (const [dt, k] of [[0, 1], [0.17, 0.7]] as const) {
    const x = envExp(sine(0.4, (u) => 58 - 22 * Math.min(1, u * 6)), 0.07, 0.004);
    biquad(x, "lp", 160);
    o.dry.add(t + dt, x, g * k);
  }
};
/** A soft notification "bloop": a rising sine blip with a bell sparkle. */
export const pop = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f = 880, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(sine(0.35, (u) => f * (0.75 + 0.35 * Math.min(1, u * 18))), 0.07, 0.003);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.35, f * 2.01), 0.04, 0.002), 0.25);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.35, f * 3.02), 0.02, 0.001), 0.12);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.35, pan);
};
export const shimmer = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, base = 2400, seed = 1) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  for (let k = 0; k < Math.round(dur * 26); k++) {
    const tt = t + r() * dur, f = base * (1 + r() * 2);
    const x = envExp(sine(0.25, f), 0.05 + r() * 0.08, 0.002);
    const w = Math.sin(Math.PI * ((tt - t) / dur));
    o.dry.add(tt, x, g * 0.05 * w, r() * 1.6 - 0.8);
    o.verb.add(tt, x, g * 0.05 * w, 0);
  }
};
/** Breath: filtered noise, inhale (rising) then exhale (falling). */
export const breath = (o: Out, t: number, inhale: number, exhale: number, g: number) => {
  const a = biquad(biquad(pink(S(inhale), Math.round(t * 17)), "bp", (i) => 900 + 700 * (i / S(inhale)), 0.8), "hp", 300);
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) a[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / a.length) ** 1.2;
  const b = biquad(biquad(pink(S(exhale), Math.round(t * 19)), "bp", (i) => 1300 - 700 * (i / S(exhale)), 0.7), "hp", 250);
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) b[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / b.length) ** 0.8;
  o.dry.add(t, a, g * 0.9);
  o.dry.add(t + inhale, b, g);
};
/** Pen on paper: short scratchy grains, one per stroke. */
export const scribble = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, g: number, seed = 5) => {
  const r = rng(seed);
  let t = t0;
  while (t < t1) {
    const d = 0.05 + r() * 0.1;
    const x = biquad(biquad(noise(S(d), Math.round(t * 1000)), "bp", 3500 + r() * 2500, 1.4), "hp", 1800);
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length) * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(i * 0.004 * (1 + r())));
    o.dry.add(t, x, g * (0.6 + 0.4 * r()), 0.15);
    t += d + r() * 0.05;
  }
};

/** Freeverb-style stereo reverb. */
export const freeverb = (x: Float32Array, spread: number, room = 0.84, damp = 0.25) => {
  const k = SR / 44100;
  const combs = [1116, 1188, 1277, 1356, 1422, 1491, 1557, 1617].map((d) => ({ b: new Float32Array(Math.round((d + spread) * k)), i: 0, f: 0 }));
  const aps = [556, 441, 341, 225].map((d) => ({ b: new Float32Array(Math.round((d + spread) * k)), i: 0 }));
  const y = new Float32Array(x.length);
  for (let n = 0; n < x.length; n++) {
    const inp = x[n] * 0.015;
    let out = 0;
    for (const c of combs) { const o = c.b[c.i]; c.f = o * (1 - damp) + c.f * damp; c.b[c.i] = inp + c.f * room; c.i = (c.i + 1) % c.b.length; out += o; }
    for (const a of aps) { const o = a.b[a.i]; a.b[a.i] = out + o * 0.5; a.i = (a.i + 1) % a.b.length; out = o - out; }
    y[n] = out;
  }
  return y;
};

/** Decode an audio file to mono float at SR. */
export const decode = (file: string) => {
  const raw = spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-i", file, "-f", "f32le", "-ac", "1", "-ar", String(SR), "-"], { maxBuffer: 1 << 30 }).stdout as Buffer;
  return new Float32Array(raw.buffer, raw.byteOffset, Math.floor(raw.length / 4));
};

/** Speech envelope → ducking gain 0…1 (attack 60 ms, release 380 ms). */
export const duckEnvelope = (vo: Float32Array) => {
  const N = vo.length, win = S(0.02), duck = new Float32Array(N);
  let env = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i += win) {
    let e = 0;
    for (let j = i; j < Math.min(N, i + win); j++) e += vo[j] * vo[j];
    const on = Math.sqrt(e / win) > 0.012 ? 1 : 0;
    const a = on > env ? 1 - Math.exp(-0.02 / 0.06) : 1 - Math.exp(-0.02 / 0.38);
    env += (on - env) * a;
    for (let j = i; j < Math.min(N, i + win); j++) duck[j] = env;
  }
  return duck;
};

export const writeWav = (file: string, l: Float32Array, r: Float32Array, k = 1) => {
  const N = l.length;
  const b = Buffer.alloc(44 + N * 4);
  b.write("RIFF", 0); b.writeUInt32LE(36 + N * 4, 4); b.write("WAVE", 8); b.write("fmt ", 12);
  b.writeUInt32LE(16, 16); b.writeUInt16LE(1, 20); b.writeUInt16LE(2, 22); b.writeUInt32LE(SR, 24); b.writeUInt32LE(SR * 4, 28);
  b.writeUInt16LE(4, 32); b.writeUInt16LE(16, 34); b.write("data", 36); b.writeUInt32LE(N * 4, 40);
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    b.writeInt16LE(Math.round(clamp(l[i] * k, -1, 1) * 32767), 44 + i * 4);
    b.writeInt16LE(Math.round(clamp(r[i] * k, -1, 1) * 32767), 46 + i * 4);
  }
  fs.writeFileSync(file, b);
};

// ── comedy kit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
/** Cartoon boing: a sine that springs up in pitch with a wobble. */
export const boing = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f0 = 180, f1 = 520, dur = 0.6, pan = 0) => {
  const x = sine(dur, (u) => (f0 + (f1 - f0) * Math.min(1, u / (dur * 0.35))) * (1 + 0.08 * Math.sin(u * 2 * Math.PI * 14) * Math.exp(-u * 4)));
  envAR(x, 0.005, dur * 0.5);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(dur, f1 * 2), 0.08, 0.002), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.3, pan);
};
/** Referee whistle: a pea-trill around 2.6 kHz. */
export const whistle = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), x = new Float32Array(n);
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / SR;
    const f = 2650 + 180 * Math.sign(Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 28 * u));
    p += (2 * Math.PI * f) / SR;
    x[i] = Math.sin(p) * (0.85 + 0.15 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 28 * u));
  }
  mixInto(x, biquad(noise(n, Math.round(t * 99)), "bp", 2650, 3), 0.25);
  envAR(x, 0.01, 0.05);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.25, pan);
};
/** Crowd cheer: band-limited noise swell with "voices" (formant wobble). */
export const cheer = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const n = S(dur);
  const x = biquad(biquad(pink(n, 55), "bp", (i) => 900 + 400 * Math.sin(i / SR * 9), 0.8), "hp", 250);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / n; x[i] *= Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.min(1, u * 1.6)) * (1 - u) * 1.4 * (0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(i / SR * 37)); }
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, 0);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.4, 0);
};
/** Rubber squeak (an aborted gesture). */
export const squeak = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const x = sine(0.16, (u) => 1400 + 900 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 6));
  envAR(x, 0.01, 0.06);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
};
/** Zipper: a fast train of clicks. */
export const zipper = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 77));
  for (let tt = 0; tt < dur; tt += 0.008 + r() * 0.006) {
    const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.02), Math.round((t + tt) * 3000)), "bp", 3500 + r() * 2500, 2), 0.003, 0.0005);
    o.dry.add(t + tt, x, g * (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin((Math.PI * tt) / dur)), pan);
  }
};
/** Clock tick-tock. */
export const ticktock = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, g: number) => {
  let k = 0;
  for (let t = t0; t < t1; t += 0.5, k++) {
    const f = k % 2 ? 2300 : 3100;
    const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.05), k + 9), "bp", f, 6), 0.006, 0.0005);
    mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.05, f * 0.5), 0.01, 0.0005), 0.3);
    o.dry.add(t, x, g, k % 2 ? 0.25 : -0.25);
  }
};
/** Sad trombone: four falling notes, the last one wobbling. */
export const sadTrombone = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => {
  const notes: [number, number][] = [[nf("D4"), 0.42], [nf("C#4"), 0.42], [nf("C4"), 0.42], [nf("B3"), 1.4]];
  let tt = t;
  notes.forEach(([f, d], k) => {
    const n = S(d), x = new Float32Array(n);
    let p = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const u = i / SR;
      const vib = k === 3 ? 1 + 0.03 * Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * 6 * u) * Math.min(1, u * 2) : 1;
      p += (2 * Math.PI * f * vib * (1 - 0.01 * Math.exp(-u * 20))) / SR;
      const ph = (p / (2 * Math.PI)) % 1;
      x[i] = 2 * ph - 1;
    }
    biquad(x, "lp", 1400, 1.5);
    biquad(x, "peak", 600, 1, 6);
    envAR(x, 0.03, k === 3 ? 0.5 : 0.06);
    o.dry.add(tt, x, g * 0.35, 0.1);
    o.verb.add(tt, x, g * 0.2, 0.1);
    tt += d;
  });
};
/** Tape rewind: a high, warbling whirr that speeds up. */
export const rewindTape = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const n = S(dur), x = new Float32Array(n);
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i / n;
    const f = 600 + 2400 * u * u + 300 * Math.sin(i / SR * 2 * Math.PI * 11);
    p += (2 * Math.PI * f) / SR;
    x[i] = Math.sin(p) * 0.4 + Math.sin(p * 1.5) * 0.2;
  }
  mixInto(x, biquad(noise(n, 31), "bp", (i) => 1500 + 3000 * (i / n), 1), 0.5);
  envAR(x, 0.05, 0.12);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, 0);
};
/** Hand clap / high five: sharp noise burst with a body thump. */
export const clap = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.25), Math.round(t * 333)), "bp", 1800, 0.9), 0.035, 0.0008);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.25, 190), 0.03, 0.001), 0.4);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
  o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.4, pan);
};
/** Sneaker step on pavers. */
export const sneakerStep = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0, seed = 1) => {
  const r = rng(Math.round(t * 1000) + seed);
  const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.12), Math.round(t * 1000) + seed), "bp", 1100 + 500 * r(), 1.2), 0.018, 0.001);
  mixInto(x, envExp(sine(0.12, 85 + 20 * r()), 0.03, 0.002), 0.5);
  mixInto(x, envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.12), seed + 7), "hp", 5000), 0.006, 0.003), 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan);
};

// ── CINÉSTORY kit: cinematic drones, hits, doors, weather beds ─────────────

/** Sustained drone: detuned saws per note, a moving low-pass and a gain curve (both functions of time in the drone). */
export const drone = (o: Out, t0: number, t1: number, notes: [string, number][], gain: (t: number) => number, cut: (t: number) => number) => {
  const n = S(t1 - t0), L = new Float32Array(n), R = new Float32Array(n);
  notes.forEach(([nn, g], k) => {
    const f = nf(nn);
    for (const [d, p] of [[-0.004, -0.5], [0.005, 0.5]] as const) {
      const s = saw(t1 - t0, f * (1 + d), k * 11 + (p > 0 ? 3 : 0));
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { L[i] += s[i] * g * (p < 0 ? 1 : 0.6); R[i] += s[i] * g * (p > 0 ? 1 : 0.6); }
    }
  });
  biquad(L, "lp", (i) => cut(i / SR), 0.7); biquad(R, "lp", (i) => cut(i / SR), 0.7);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const g = gain(i / SR) * smooth(0, 1.2, i / SR) * (1 - smooth(t1 - t0 - 1.2, t1 - t0, i / SR)); L[i] *= g; R[i] *= g; }
  o.dry.addSt(t0, L, R, 0.5);
  o.verb.addSt(t0, L, R, 0.35);
};
/** Low cinematic boom (sub drop + noise body). */
export const boom = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, f = 48) => {
  const x = envExp(sine(2.2, (u) => f + 30 * Math.exp(-u * 6)), 0.7, 0.003);
  const body = envExp(biquad(noise(S(1.2), 91), "lp", 300), 0.25, 0.002);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g); o.dry.add(t, body, g * 0.5); o.verb.add(t, body, g * 0.6);
};
/** Rising swell into a moment (filtered noise + a glide). */
export const riser = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const n = S(dur), x = pink(n, 61);
  biquad(x, "bp", (i) => 300 + 5000 * (i / n) ** 2, 0.9);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) x[i] *= (i / n) ** 2.2;
  const tone = sine(dur, (u) => 110 * 2 ** (2 * (u / dur)));
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) tone[i] *= 0.15 * (i / n) ** 3;
  o.dry.add(t, x, g); o.dry.add(t, tone, g); o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.5);
};
/** Three knuckle knocks on wood. */
export const knock = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, n = 3, gap = 0.3) => {
  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    const x = envExp(biquad(noise(S(0.12), 33 + k), "bp", 420, 1.2), 0.035, 0.001);
    const b = envExp(sine(0.15, 150), 0.03, 0.001);
    o.dry.add(t + k * gap, x, g * 2.2); o.dry.add(t + k * gap, b, g * 0.6); o.verb.add(t + k * gap, x, g * 0.8);
  }
};
/** Wooden creak: a slowly gliding rough resonance. */
export const creak = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number, base = 180, pan = 0) => {
  const n = S(dur), r = rng(7 + Math.round(base));
  const x = new Float32Array(n);
  let ph = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / n; const f = base * (1 + 0.6 * Math.sin(u * Math.PI) + 0.1 * (r() - 0.5)); ph += f / SR; x[i] = (ph % 1 < 0.12 ? 1 : 0) * (0.6 + 0.4 * r()); }
  biquad(x, "bp", base * 4, 3); envAR(x, 0.05, 0.1);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan); o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.4, pan);
};
export const doorOpen = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => { click(o, t, 1800, g * 0.5, 0.2); creak(o, t + 0.08, 0.9, g * 0.8, 210, 0.2); };
export const doorClose = (o: Out, t: number, g: number) => { creak(o, t, 0.35, g * 0.4, 260, 0.2); thud(o, t + 0.32, g * 1.4, 70, 0.16, 0.2); click(o, t + 0.34, 2400, g * 0.4, 0.2); };
/** Ship's / foghorn blast. */
export const foghorn = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, dur = 2.6) => {
  const x = saw(dur, 92, 5), y = saw(dur, 92 * 1.498, 9);
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] = x[i] * 0.6 + y[i] * 0.4;
  biquad(x, "lp", 700, 0.8); envAR(x, 0.25, 0.6);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g); o.verb.add(t, x, g * 1.2);
};
/** Radio static burst with a faint tone underneath. */
export const radio = (o: Out, t: number, dur: number, g: number) => {
  const x = biquad(biquad(noise(S(dur), 71), "bp", 2200, 0.6), "hp", 500);
  const r = rng(72);
  for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] *= 0.5 + 0.5 * (Math.sin(i / SR * 37 + r() * 0.3) > -0.2 ? 1 : 0.2);
  envAR(x, 0.03, 0.15);
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, 0.3);
};
/** A gull's cry. */
export const gull = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0) => {
  for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    const d = 0.22 + 0.05 * k, x = sine(d, (u) => 1700 + 900 * Math.sin((u / d) * Math.PI) - 300 * k);
    for (let i = 0; i < x.length; i++) x[i] = Math.tanh(x[i] * 3) * Math.sin((Math.PI * i) / x.length);
    biquad(x, "bp", 2000, 1.2);
    o.dry.add(t + k * 0.28, x, g, pan); o.verb.add(t + k * 0.28, x, g * 0.7, pan);
  }
};
/** One wave breaking on rocks (noise burst with a long hiss tail). */
export const waveCrash = (o: Out, t: number, g: number, pan = 0, dist = 0) => {
  const n = S(3.5), x = pink(n, 300 + Math.round(t * 10));
  biquad(x, "lp", 2600 - 1800 * dist, 0.7);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const u = i / SR; x[i] *= smooth(0, 0.35, u) * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, u - 0.35) * 1.1); }
  o.dry.add(t, x, g, pan); o.verb.add(t, x, g * 0.5, pan);
};

==== 5834 project/scripts/transcribe.mjs
// Word timings for a voice-over → JSON [[word, start, end], …] (VO seconds).
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> --out=stories/<id>/words.json [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id]
//   node scripts/transcribe.mjs <any/path/vo.mp3> --id=<id> [--script=…]   copies the VO to public/audio/<id>.<ext>
//                                                                          and writes stories/<id>/words.json
//
// 1. whisper.cpp when available (WHISPER_CLI + WHISPER_MODEL, or `whisper-cli` on PATH with a model in
//    ~/.cache/whisper.cpp or ./models) — real word timings; with --script the script's words are kept
//    (names and numbers spelled as written) and timed by whisper.
// 2. otherwise, with the script text: every speech segment of the VO (silence detection) is given its run of
//    script words by a global alignment (scripts/align.mjs) — sentence starts land on the right pause from
//    the first to the last line (no drift), word timing inside a phrase ≈ ±0.3 s.
// --method=script forces 2 even when whisper.cpp is installed.
// Without whisper and without a script there is nothing to align: the script text must be provided.

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { alignScript, scriptOnWhisper, speechSegments } from "./align.mjs";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
const id = opt("id");
if (id && !/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(id)) { console.error(`--id "${id}" must use only a-z, 0-9 and "-"`); process.exit(1); }
const out = opt("out") || (id ? `stories/${id}/words.json` : "");
if (file && fs.existsSync(file) && id) {
  const dst = path.join("public", "audio", `${id}${path.extname(file).toLowerCase() || ".mp3"}`);
  fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dst), { recursive: true });
  if (path.resolve(dst) !== path.resolve(file)) fs.copyFileSync(file, dst);
  console.log(`vo: ${dst}  →  story.json "vo": { "file": "${path.relative("public", dst)}", "offset": 1.5 }`);
}
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file) || !out) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/transcribe.mjs <vo.mp3> (--id=<id> | --out=stories/<id>/words.json) [--script=script.txt] [--lang=id] [--method=script]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const run = (cmd, a) => spawnSync(cmd, a, { encoding: "utf8", maxBuffer: 1 << 28 });
const duration = Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", file]).stdout.trim());

const findWhisper = () => {
  const home = os.homedir();
  const cands = [process.env.WHISPER_CLI, run("sh", ["-c", "command -v whisper-cli"]).stdout.trim(), "/opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli", "/usr/local/bin/whisper-cli"].filter(Boolean);
  const cli = cands.find((c) => fs.existsSync(c));
  const modelDirs = [path.join(home, ".cache/whisper.cpp"), path.resolve("models"), "/opt/homebrew/share/whisper-cpp"];
  let model = process.env.WHISPER_MODEL && fs.existsSync(process.env.WHISPER_MODEL) ? process.env.WHISPER_MODEL : null;
  if (!model) for (const d of modelDirs) { if (!fs.existsSync(d)) continue; const m = fs.readdirSync(d).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".bin")).sort((a, b) => (b.includes("large") ? 1 : 0) - (a.includes("large") ? 1 : 0))[0]; if (m) { model = path.join(d, m); break; } }
  return cli && model ? { cli, model } : null;
};

let words = null, method = "";
const method0 = opt("method", "auto");
const W = method0 === "script" ? null : findWhisper();
if (W) {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-vo-"));
  const wav = path.join(tmp, "vo16k.wav");
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", file, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", wav]);
  run(W.cli, ["-m", W.model, "-f", wav, "-l", opt("lang", "id"), "-ml", "1", "-sow", "-ojf", "-of", path.join(tmp, "w")]);
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, "w.json"), "utf8"));
    words = j.transcription.map((s) => [s.text.trim(), s.offsets.from / 1000, s.offsets.to / 1000]).filter((w) => w[0]);
    method = `whisper.cpp (${path.basename(W.model)})`;
    const sf = opt("script");
    if (sf && fs.existsSync(sf) && words.length) {
      const m = scriptOnWhisper(fs.readFileSync(sf, "utf8"), words);
      if (m.matched >= 0.6) { words = m.words; method += `, script words timed by whisper (${Math.round(m.matched * 100)} % matched)`; }
      else method += ` — the script matches only ${Math.round(m.matched * 100)} % of what was heard: whisper's own words kept (is it the right script?)`;
    }
  } catch { words = null; }
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

if (!words) {
  const scriptFile = opt("script");
  if (!scriptFile || !fs.existsSync(scriptFile)) {
    console.error("No whisper.cpp found and no --script given. Provide the narration text (e.g. --script=stories/<id>/script.txt) or install whisper.cpp (see the skill's references/cinestory/setup.md).");
    process.exit(2);
  }
  const segs = speechSegments(file, duration);
  const r = alignScript(fs.readFileSync(scriptFile, "utf8"), segs);
  if (!r) { console.error("Could not align: no speech found in the VO, or the script is empty."); process.exit(3); }
  words = r.words;
  method = `script aligned to ${r.segments} speech segments (${r.clauses} script phrases, ${r.rate.toFixed(1)} syllables/s); word timing inside a phrase ≈ ±0.3 s`;
  for (const w of r.warnings) console.log(`  ⚠ ${w}`);
}

fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(out), { recursive: true });
fs.writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify(words.map(([w, a, b]) => [w, +a.toFixed(2), +b.toFixed(2)])));
console.log(`words: ${out} — ${words.length} words, ${duration.toFixed(2)} s, via ${method}`);
console.log(words.map(([w, a]) => `${a.toFixed(2)} ${w}`).join("  "));

==== 2032 project/scripts/tts.mjs
// Offline narration with the operating system's voice (only with the user's approval — it is a
// stand-in for a real voice-over). macOS: `say` (Indonesian voice "Damayanti"). Writes an MP3 and,
// because the text is known, the word timings too.
//   node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <public/audio/<id>.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const [scriptFile, outMp3] = process.argv.slice(2).filter((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (process.argv.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d ?? ""}`).split("=").slice(1).join("=");
if (!scriptFile || !outMp3) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/tts.mjs <script.txt> <out.mp3> --words=stories/<id>/words.json [--voice=Damayanti] [--rate=170]");
  process.exit(1);
}
if (process.platform !== "darwin") {
  console.error("Built-in TTS is only wired for macOS (`say`). On other systems record or generate the voice-over elsewhere and use scripts/transcribe.mjs.");
  process.exit(2);
}
const voice = opt("voice", "Damayanti"), rate = opt("rate", "170");
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "cf-tts-"));
const aiff = path.join(tmp, "vo.aiff");
const r = spawnSync("say", ["-v", voice, "-r", rate, "-o", aiff, "-f", scriptFile], { encoding: "utf8" });
if (r.status !== 0) { console.error(r.stderr || `say failed (voice "${voice}" installed?)`); process.exit(3); }
fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(outMp3), { recursive: true });
spawnSync("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", aiff, "-af", "apad=pad_dur=0.2", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "1", "-b:a", "160k", outMp3]);
fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log(`tts: ${outMp3} (${voice}, rate ${rate})`);
const words = opt("words");
if (words) {
  const t = spawnSync("node", [path.join("scripts", "transcribe.mjs"), outMp3, `--out=${words}`, `--script=${scriptFile}`], { stdio: "inherit" });
  process.exit(t.status ?? 0);
}

==== 3047 project/scripts/vo-analyze.mjs
// Read the real timing of a voice-over: duration, pauses and phrases (stretches of speech between
// pauses). Optional word timings when whisper.cpp is available (set WHISPER_CLI and WHISPER_MODEL).
// Write cuts in VO seconds from this output — never from a guessed script length.
//   node scripts/vo-analyze.mjs public/audio/vo.mp3 [--noise=-38] [--pause=0.25] [--lang=id]

import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import fs from "node:fs";
import os from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";

const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const file = args.find((a) => !a.startsWith("--"));
const opt = (k, d) => (args.find((a) => a.startsWith(`--${k}=`)) ?? `=${d}`).split("=")[1];
if (!file || !fs.existsSync(file)) {
  console.error("usage: node scripts/vo-analyze.mjs <audio.mp3|wav> [--noise=-38] [--pause=0.25] [--lang=id]");
  process.exit(1);
}
const run = (cmd, a) => spawnSync(cmd, a, { encoding: "utf8" });
const duration = Number(run("ffprobe", ["-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", file]).stdout.trim());
const log = run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "info", "-i", file, "-af", `silencedetect=n=${opt("noise", -38)}dB:d=${opt("pause", 0.25)}`, "-f", "null", "-"]).stderr;
const starts = [...log.matchAll(/silence_start: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
const ends = [...log.matchAll(/silence_end: ([\d.]+)/g)].map((m) => Number(m[1]));
const pauses = starts.map((s, i) => ({ start: s, end: ends[i] ?? duration }));
// phrases = speech between pauses
const phrases = [];
let cur = 0;
for (const p of pauses) {
  if (p.start - cur > 0.15) phrases.push({ start: +cur.toFixed(2), end: +p.start.toFixed(2) });
  cur = p.end;
}
if (duration - cur > 0.15) phrases.push({ start: +cur.toFixed(2), end: +duration.toFixed(2) });

let words = null;
const cli = process.env.WHISPER_CLI, model = process.env.WHISPER_MODEL;
if (cli && model && fs.existsSync(cli) && fs.existsSync(model)) {
  const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "vo-"));
  const wav = path.join(tmp, "vo16k.wav");
  run("ffmpeg", ["-v", "error", "-y", "-i", file, "-ar", "16000", "-ac", "1", wav]);
  run(cli, ["-m", model, "-f", wav, "-l", opt("lang", "id"), "-ml", "1", "-sow", "-ojf", "-of", path.join(tmp, "w")]);
  try {
    const j = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmp, "w.json"), "utf8"));
    words = j.transcription.map((s) => ({ t: s.offsets.from / 1000, w: s.text.trim() })).filter((x) => x.w);
  } catch {}
  fs.rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

const out = { file, duration: +duration.toFixed(3), firstSpeech: phrases[0]?.start ?? 0, pauses, phrases, words };
const json = file.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") + ".timing.json";
fs.writeFileSync(json, JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
console.log(`duration ${out.duration} s · speech starts ${out.firstSpeech} s · ${phrases.length} phrases · ${pauses.length} pauses${words ? ` · ${words.length} words` : ""}`);
for (const p of phrases) console.log(`  ${p.start.toFixed(2).padStart(7)} – ${p.end.toFixed(2).padStart(7)} s`);
console.log(`timing: ${json}`);

==== 4209 project/scripts/worlds.mjs
// The world catalog: every reusable world in this project, so a film starts from a finished set instead of a
// new one. Without an id it lists them; with an id it prints what a story can name in that world.
//   node scripts/worlds.mjs            → id, times, places and a one-line description of every world
//   node scripts/worlds.mjs rumah      → its places with marks, seats / beds, POIs and set props

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

const ls = (dir, ext) => (fs.existsSync(dir) ? fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(ext)).map((f) => path.join(dir, f)) : []);
const files = [...ls("worlds", ".world.json"), ...(fs.existsSync("stories") ? fs.readdirSync("stories", { withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isDirectory()).flatMap((e) => ls(path.join("stories", e.name), ".world.json")) : [])];
const worlds = files.map((f) => { try { return { file: f, ...JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")) }; } catch (e) { console.error(`✗ ${f}: ${e.message}`); return null; } }).filter(Boolean);
// object anchors decide the automatic marks (<id>:seat, <id>:bed, <id>:behind …)
const anchors = {};
for (const f of [...ls("library/objects", ".json"), ...ls("assets/objects", ".json")]) { try { const o = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")); anchors[o.id] = Object.keys(o.anchors ?? {}); } catch { /* not an object file */ } }
const BUILTIN = { kos: "boarding house (kos): room, long hallway, front yard — see references/cinestory/worlds.md", coast: "rocky headland with a lighthouse, the keeper's cottage and the sea — see references/cinestory/worlds.md" };

const id = process.argv[2];
if (!id) {
  console.log("Built-in worlds:");

  console.log("\nReady-made worlds (world.json):");
  for (const w of worlds) console.log(`  ${String(w.id).padEnd(14)} [${(w.times ?? []).join(", ")}] places: ${Object.keys(w.places ?? {}).join(", ")}\n  ${"".padEnd(14)} ${w.doc ?? ""}\n  ${"".padEnd(14)} ${w.file}`);
  console.log("\nDetails: node scripts/worlds.mjs <id>   ·   use it in story.json: \"world\": \"<id>\"");
  process.exit(0);
}
if (BUILTIN[id]) { console.log(`${id}: ${BUILTIN[id]}`); process.exit(0); }
const w = worlds.find((x) => x.id === id);
if (!w) { console.error(`✗ no world "${id}" — available: ${[...Object.keys(BUILTIN), ...worlds.map((x) => x.id)].join(", ")}`); process.exit(1); }

const inRect = (p, r) => p[0] >= r[0] && p[0] <= r[2] && p[1] >= r[1] && p[1] <= r[3];
const rooms = Object.fromEntries((w.rooms ?? []).map((r) => [r.id, r.rect]));
const where = (pl, at) => (pl.kind === "interior" ? (pl.rooms ?? []).some((r) => rooms[r] && inRect(at, rooms[r])) : pl.area ? inRect(at, pl.area) : false);
const xz = (o) => (o.at.length === 3 ? [o.at[0], o.at[2]] : o.at);
console.log(`# ${w.id} — ${w.doc}\n\nfile: ${w.file}\ntimes: ${(w.times ?? []).join(", ")}\n`);
for (const [pid, pl] of Object.entries(w.places ?? {})) {
  console.log(`## place "${pid}" (${pl.kind}) — ${pl.doc ?? ""}`);
  for (const [m, v] of Object.entries(pl.marks ?? {})) console.log(`  mark   ${m.padEnd(22)} ${v.doc ?? ""}`);
  const here = (w.objects ?? []).filter((o) => o.id && where(pl, xz(o)));
  const auto = here.flatMap((o) => (anchors[o.use] ?? []).filter((a) => ["seat", "bed", "behind", "push"].includes(a)).map((a) => `${o.id}:${a}`));
  if (auto.length) console.log(`  seats / beds / sides: ${auto.join(", ")}`);
  if (here.length) console.log(`  objects (targets, <id>:front): ${here.map((o) => `${o.id} (${o.use})`).join(", ")}`);
  const doors = (pl.rooms ?? []).flatMap((r) => ((w.rooms ?? []).find((x) => x.id === r)?.openings ?? []).filter((o) => o.id && o.type !== "arch" && o.type !== "window").map((o) => o.id));
  if (doors.length) console.log(`  doors (set "<id>": 1 opens): ${[...new Set(doors)].join(", ")}`);
  console.log(`  ambience ${pl.ambience ?? "room"} · footsteps ${pl.surface ?? "-"} · view ${pl.view ?? "-"}\n`);
}
if (w.props && Object.keys(w.props).length) {
  console.log("## set props (scene / beat \"set\")");
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(w.props)) console.log(`  ${k.padEnd(18)} default ${v.default} — ${v.doc ?? ""}`);
}

==== 31318 project/src/cine/character/Character.tsx
// CINÉSTORY character: one procedural rig, many people. A CharSpec (the character bible as data) sets
// skin, hair style, face shape, wardrobe and proportions; the rig is posed per frame from a Pose
// (pose.ts). Head = one sculpted sphere (brow ridge, sockets, nose, cheekbones, lips, chin), eyes with
// lids + lash lines; arms FK or 2-bone IK toward a target in chest space (door handle, key, phone).

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { CapsuleGeometry, DoubleSide, SphereGeometry, Euler, type Material, Matrix4, MeshPhysicalMaterial, Quaternion, Vector3 } from "three";
import { cached, lathe, sphere, torus, box, cyl } from "../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { mulberry32 } from "../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import { batikTex, eyeTex, phys, weaveTex } from "../mats.ts";
import type { Arm, Hand, Hold, Leg, Pose } from "./pose.ts";

export type CharSpec = {
  key: string;
  skin: string; hair: string; iris: string; lip: string; brow: string;
  /** whole-body scale (1 = 1.80 m) and head scale */
  scale: number; headScale: number;
  top: "hoodie" | "tee" | "jacket"; topColor: string; trim: string;
  legs: string; feet: "sandal" | "shoe"; sandal: string;
  hairStyle: "crop" | "messy" | "long" | "bald";
  /** face shape: jaw width, cheek fullness, nose length, brow thickness, chin (all ~0..1, 0.5 neutral) */
  face: { jaw: number; cheek: number; nose: number; brow: number; chin: number };
  /** batik shirt pattern (ink colour on topColor) and glasses */
  batik?: string; glasses?: boolean;
  /** knit cap colour, hijab colour (covers hair + neck), beard colour (chin, cheeks, moustache) */
  cap?: string; hijab?: string; beard?: string;
};

const skinMat = (c: string) => phys(`skin${c}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.5, sheen: 0.4, sheenColor: "#ff9f80", sheenRoughness: 0.45, clearcoat: 0.08, clearcoatRoughness: 0.5 });
const fabric = (key: string, c: string, o: Partial<ConstructorParameters<typeof MeshPhysicalMaterial>[0]> = {}) =>
  phys(`fab${key}`, { color: c, roughness: 0.88, sheen: 0.45, sheenColor: "#9aa8c8", sheenRoughness: 0.55, ...o });

const clothes = (c: CharSpec) => {
  const top = c.batik
    ? fabric(`top${c.key}`, "#ffffff", { map: batikTex(`top${c.key}`, c.topColor, c.batik, [3, 3]) })
    : fabric(`top${c.key}`, "#ffffff", { map: weaveTex(`top${c.key}`, c.topColor, [7, 7]) });
  return {
    top,
    sleeve: top,
    pocket: fabric(`pocket${c.key}`, "#e4e6ea", { map: weaveTex(`top${c.key}`, c.topColor, [7, 7]) }),
    legs: fabric(`legs${c.key}`, c.legs, { sheen: 0.5, sheenColor: "#8f97a8" }),
    trim: fabric(`trim${c.key}`, c.trim, { sheen: 0.2 }),
    sole: phys(`sole${c.sandal}`, { color: c.sandal, roughness: 0.7 }),
  };
};

// ── geometry ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Tapered limb along −Y from 0 to −len with round caps. */
const limb = (len: number, r0: number, r1: number, mid = 0) =>
  cached(`limb${len},${r0},${r1},${mid}`, () => {
    const pts: [number, number][] = [];
    const n = 8;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * (Math.PI / 2);
      pts.push([Math.sin(a) * r1, -len - Math.cos(a) * r1]);
    }
    for (let i = 1; i < 10; i++) {
      const k = i / 10;
      const bulge = Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * mid;
      pts.push([r1 + (r0 - r1) * k + bulge, -len + len * k]);
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const a = (i / n) * (Math.PI / 2);
      pts.push([Math.cos(a) * r0, Math.sin(a) * r0]);
    }
    return lathe(`limbL${len},${r0},${r1},${mid}`, pts, 28);
  });

const TORSO: [number, number][] = [
  [0.0, -0.36], [0.172, -0.356], [0.19, -0.336], [0.188, -0.3], [0.191, -0.2], [0.2, -0.06], [0.21, 0.07], [0.216, 0.15],
  [0.207, 0.205], [0.18, 0.238], [0.13, 0.262], [0.08, 0.274], [0.0, 0.279],
];
const PELVIS: [number, number][] = [[0, -0.13], [0.115, -0.125], [0.155, -0.08], [0.162, 0.0], [0.158, 0.09], [0.0, 0.1]];
const capsule = (r: number, l: number) => cached(`cap${r},${l}`, () => new CapsuleGeometry(r, l, 6, 14));

const g2 = (x: number, y: number, sx: number, sy: number) => Math.exp(-(x * x) / (sx * sx) - (y * y) / (sy * sy));

/** Sculpt a unit-sphere point into the head surface (+Z = face), in head units. Shape knobs from the spec. */
const sculpt = (x: number, y: number, z: number, f: CharSpec["face"]): [number, number, number] => {
  const front = Math.max(0, z);
  const ax = Math.abs(x);
  // displacement along the normal (unit sphere: normal = position)
  let d = 0;
  d += 0.035 * (0.6 + f.brow) * g2(ax - 0.3, y - 0.27, 0.32, 0.075) * Math.pow(front, 2); // brow ridge
  d -= 0.06 * g2(ax - 0.375, y - 0.07, 0.17, 0.12) * front; // eye sockets
  const ridge = g2(x, 0, 0.075, 1) * (y < 0.18 && y > -0.33 ? Math.pow((0.18 - y) / 0.51, 1.3) : 0);
  d += (0.2 + 0.08 * f.nose) * ridge * Math.pow(front, 4); // nose bridge → tip
  d += 0.1 * g2(x, y + 0.27, 0.075, 0.065) * front; // tip
  d += 0.06 * g2(ax - 0.12, y + 0.3, 0.06, 0.05) * front; // nostril wings
  d -= 0.025 * g2(ax - 0.2, y + 0.38, 0.05, 0.06) * front; // nasolabial
  d += 0.035 * (0.5 + f.cheek) * g2(ax - 0.55, y + 0.05, 0.2, 0.16) * front; // cheekbones
  d += 0.022 * g2(x, y + 0.5, 0.17, 0.035) * front; // upper lip
  d += 0.026 * g2(x, y + 0.6, 0.15, 0.04) * front; // lower lip
  d -= 0.018 * g2(x, y + 0.69, 0.18, 0.03) * front; // under-lip groove
  d += (0.03 + 0.04 * f.chin) * g2(x, y + 0.82, 0.2, 0.08) * front; // chin
  x *= 1 + d; y *= 1 + d; z *= 1 + d;
  // jaw taper (narrower lower face), forward chin, fuller lower cheeks
  const low = Math.max(0, -y);
  x *= 1 - (0.24 - 0.12 * f.jaw) * Math.pow(low, 1.5);
  z += 0.14 * low * Math.max(0, z) * Math.max(0, z);
  y *= 1 + 0.12 * low;
  return [x * 0.102, y * 0.118, z * 0.112];
};

/** Sculpted head on a unit sphere, then scaled to head size. */
const headGeo = (f: CharSpec["face"]) =>
  cached(`head${f.jaw},${f.cheek},${f.nose},${f.brow},${f.chin}`, () => {
    const g = new SphereGeometry(1, 96, 72);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) a.setXYZ(i, ...sculpt(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i), f));
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });

/** A shell that follows the sculpted head: `lift(ux, uy, uz)` (relative, on the unit sphere) > 0 stands off the
 *  skin, < 0 dives under it. The skin hides the dived part, so edges are smooth curves (no cut triangles). */
const skinShell = (key: string, f: CharSpec["face"], lift: (x: number, y: number, z: number) => number) =>
  cached(`shell${key}${f.jaw},${f.cheek},${f.nose},${f.brow},${f.chin}`, () => {
    const g = new SphereGeometry(1, 96, 72);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const ux = a.getX(i), uy = a.getY(i), uz = a.getZ(i);
      const [x, y, z] = sculpt(ux, uy, uz, f);
      const k = 1 + lift(ux, uy, uz);
      a.setXYZ(i, x * k, y * k, z * k);
    }
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });
const sstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };

/** Hijab: lifted head surface with an oval face opening; extra volume behind and wrapping under the chin. */
const hijabGeo = (f: CharSpec["face"]) =>
  skinShell("hijab", f, (x, y, z) => {
    const o = (x / 0.6) ** 2 + ((y + 0.04) / 0.8) ** 2;
    const open = sstep(1.12, 0.9, o) * sstep(0.0, 0.25, z);
    const lift = 0.09 + 0.06 * Math.max(0, -z) + 0.1 * Math.max(0, y - 0.6) + 0.3 * Math.max(0, -y - 0.6) * (1 - 0.6 * Math.max(0, z));
    return lift * (1 - open) - 0.06 * open;
  });

/** Beard: jaw, chin and cheeks below the cheekbones, a gap for the mouth; dives under the skin elsewhere. */
const beardGeo = (f: CharSpec["face"]) =>
  skinShell("beard", f, (x, y, z) => {
    const jaw = sstep(-0.4, -0.58, y) * sstep(-0.35, 0.05, z);
    const mouth = Math.exp(-(x * x) / (0.2 * 0.2) - ((y + 0.55) ** 2) / (0.09 * 0.09));
    const m = jaw * (1 - 0.95 * mouth);
    return 0.05 * m - 0.04 * (1 - m);
  });

/** Open sphere shell (phi start/length around Y, theta from the top), for caps, hijab and long hair. */
const shell = (phi0: number, phiL: number, th0: number, thL: number) =>
  cached(`shell${phi0},${phiL},${th0},${thL}`, () => new SphereGeometry(1, 48, 24, phi0, phiL, th0, thL));

// ── IK ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const UA = 0.28, FA = 0.25;
const _q = new Quaternion();
const ikArm = (S: Vector3, T: Vector3, pole: Vector3) => {
  const d0 = new Vector3().subVectors(T, S);
  const d = Math.min(Math.max(d0.length(), Math.abs(UA - FA) + 1e-3), UA + FA - 1e-3);
  const u = d0.normalize();
  const cosA = (UA * UA + d * d - FA * FA) / (2 * UA * d);
  const sinA = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - cosA * cosA));
  const w = pole.clone().addScaledVector(u, -pole.dot(u));
  if (w.lengthSq() < 1e-8) w.set(0, 0, -1).addScaledVector(u, -u.z);
  w.normalize();
  const upper = u.clone().multiplyScalar(cosA).addScaledVector(w, sinA).normalize();
  const E = S.clone().addScaledVector(upper, UA);
  const fore = new Vector3().subVectors(S.clone().addScaledVector(u, d), E).normalize();
  const cosB = Math.min(1, Math.max(-1, upper.dot(fore)));
  const bend = Math.acos(cosB);
  const Y = upper.clone().negate();
  let Z = fore.clone().addScaledVector(upper, -fore.dot(upper));
  if (Z.lengthSq() < 1e-8) Z = w.clone().negate();
  Z.normalize();
  const X = new Vector3().crossVectors(Y, Z).normalize();
  Z.crossVectors(X, Y).normalize();
  const m = new Matrix4().makeBasis(X, Y, Z);
  return { q: new Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(m), bend };
};

// ── parts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const HandMesh: React.FC<{ s: number; h: Hand; skin: Material; t: number; tremble: number }> = ({ s, h, skin, t, tremble }) => {
  const fingers = [0.026, 0.009, -0.008, -0.025];
  const tr = tremble * 0.09;
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={box(0.03, 0.085, 0.074, 0.013)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.05, 0.002]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {fingers.map((fz, i) => {
        const c = i === 0 ? h.index : h.curl;
        const jit = tr * Math.sin(t * 41 + i * 1.7);
        const a = -s * (c * 1.4 + jit);
        return (
          <group key={i} position={[0, -0.09, fz]} rotation={[0, 0, a]}>
            <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0088, 0.03)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.022, 0]} castShadow />
            <group position={[0, -0.045, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, a * 0.9]}>
              <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0082, 0.022)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.017, 0]} castShadow />
            </group>
          </group>
        );
      })}
      <group position={[-s * 0.006, -0.025, 0.036]} rotation={new Euler(0.5, 0, -s * (0.35 + h.thumb * 0.8))}>
        <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0105, 0.035)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.025, 0]} castShadow />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

const Phone: React.FC<{ screen: Material; s: number }> = ({ screen, s }) => (
  <group position={[-s * 0.024, -0.075, 0.012]}>
    <mesh geometry={box(0.009, 0.152, 0.074, 0.004)} material={phys("phoneBody", { color: "#16181c", roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0.6 })} castShadow />
    <mesh geometry={box(0.001, 0.146, 0.068, 0.0005)} material={screen} position={[-s * 0.0048, 0, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI, s > 0 ? Math.PI : 0, 0]} />
  </group>
);

/** Props held in one hand (hand space: fingers along −Y, forward +Z). Binoculars are drawn at the eyes by Head. */
const metal = () => phys("propMetal", { color: "#2a2c30", roughness: 0.35, metalness: 0.7 });
const HeldProp: React.FC<{ h: Hold; s: number }> = ({ h, s }) => {
  if (h.kind === "lantern") {
    const glow = phys(`lanternGlass${Math.round(h.on * 20)}`, { color: "#ffe2b0", emissive: "#ffb45e", emissiveIntensity: 0.2 + 2.6 * h.on, roughness: 0.2, transmission: 0.2 });
    return (
      <group position={[0, -0.13, 0.02]}>
        <mesh geometry={torus(0.035, 0.004, 6, 20, Math.PI)} material={metal()} position={[0, 0.05, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.045, 0.05, 0.02, 16)} material={metal()} position={[0, 0.0, 0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.04, 0.11, 16)} material={glow} position={[0, -0.065, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.05, 0.055, 0.02, 16)} material={metal()} position={[0, -0.13, 0]} castShadow />
      </group>
    );
  }
  if (h.kind === "flashlight") {
    const lens = phys(`torchLens${Math.round(h.on * 20)}`, { color: "#fff6e0", emissive: "#fff2d0", emissiveIntensity: 3 * h.on, roughness: 0.1 });
    return (
      <group position={[0, -0.06, 0.03]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.017, 0.017, 0.17, 16)} material={metal()} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.026, 0.018, 0.05, 16)} material={metal()} position={[0, 0.1, 0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.023, 0.023, 0.004, 16)} material={lens} position={[0, 0.126, 0]} />
      </group>
    );
  }
  if (h.kind === "mug") return <mesh geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.036, 0.1, 18)} material={phys("mug", { color: "#d8d2c4", roughness: 0.4, clearcoat: 0.5 })} position={[-s * 0.045, -0.075, 0.03]} castShadow />;
  if (h.kind === "book") return <mesh geometry={box(0.035, 0.22, 0.16, 0.008)} material={phys("book", { color: "#5a3b2a", roughness: 0.8 })} position={[-s * 0.03, -0.1, 0.0]} castShadow />;
  if (h.kind === "pen") return <mesh geometry={cyl(0.004, 0.004, 0.13, 6)} material={phys("pen", { color: "#1d2b4a", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0, -0.09, 0.03]} rotation={[0.9, 0, 0]} />;
  if (h.kind === "binoculars") return <Binoculars />;
  return null;
};
const Binoculars: React.FC = () => (
  <group rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
    {[1, -1].map((k) => (
      <group key={k} position={[k * 0.034, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.021, 0.024, 0.12, 16)} material={metal()} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.026, 0.026, 0.02, 16)} material={phys("binoRub", { color: "#121315", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, 0.07, 0]} />
      </group>
    ))}
    <mesh geometry={box(0.05, 0.05, 0.024, 0.008)} material={metal()} />
  </group>
);

const ArmSide: React.FC<{ s: number; a: Arm; hand: Hand; c: CharSpec; t: number; tremble: number; phone?: Material; hold?: Hold | null }> = ({ s, a, hand, c, t, tremble, phone, hold }) => {
  const S = new Vector3(s * 0.19, 0.2, -0.01);
  const cl = clothes(c);
  let q: Quaternion;
  let el = a.el;
  const fk = new Quaternion().setFromEuler(new Euler(-a.sw, s * a.tw, s * a.ab, "XZY"));
  if (a.ik && a.ik.w > 0) {
    const T = new Vector3(a.ik.t[0] * s, a.ik.t[1], a.ik.t[2]);
    const pole = new Vector3(a.ik.pole[0] * s, a.ik.pole[1], a.ik.pole[2]);
    const r = ikArm(S, T, pole);
    q = fk.clone().slerp(r.q, a.ik.w);
    el = el + (r.bend - el) * a.ik.w;
  } else q = fk;
  const jit = tremble * 0.06;
  const wr = new Euler(a.wr[0] + jit * Math.sin(t * 37), s * a.wr[1], s * a.wr[2] + jit * Math.sin(t * 29 + 1), "XYZ");
  const skin = skinMat(c.skin);
  const short = c.top === "tee";
  return (
    <group position={S} quaternion={q}>
      {short ? (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={limb(0.14, 0.064, 0.058)} material={cl.sleeve} castShadow receiveShadow />
          <mesh geometry={limb(0.28, 0.044, 0.037)} material={skin} castShadow receiveShadow />
        </>
      ) : (
        <mesh geometry={limb(0.28, 0.064, 0.054, 0.007)} material={cl.sleeve} castShadow receiveShadow />
      )}
      <group position={[0, -UA, 0]} rotation={[-el, 0, 0]}>
        {short ? (
          <mesh geometry={limb(0.25, 0.037, 0.03, 0.004)} material={skin} castShadow receiveShadow />
        ) : (
          <>
            <mesh geometry={limb(0.225, 0.054, 0.047, 0.005)} material={cl.sleeve} castShadow receiveShadow />
            <mesh geometry={cyl(0.042, 0.04, 0.045, 20)} material={cl.sleeve} position={[0, -0.222, 0]} castShadow />
          </>
        )}
        <group position={[0, -FA, 0]} quaternion={_q.setFromEuler(wr).clone()}>
          <HandMesh s={s} h={hand} skin={skin} t={t} tremble={tremble} />
          {phone ? <Phone screen={phone} s={s} /> : null}
          {hold && !(hold.kind === "binoculars" && hold.on > 0.6) ? <HeldProp h={hold} s={s} /> : null}
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

const LegSide: React.FC<{ s: number; l: Leg; c: CharSpec }> = ({ s, l, c }) => {
  const cl = clothes(c);
  const skin = skinMat(c.skin);
  return (
    <group position={[s * 0.095, -0.05, 0]} rotation={new Euler(-l.sw, s * l.tw, s * l.ab, "XZY")}>
      <mesh geometry={limb(0.43, 0.09, 0.07, 0.005)} material={cl.legs} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <group position={[0, -0.43, 0]} rotation={[l.kn, 0, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={limb(0.38, 0.066, 0.052, 0.012)} material={cl.legs} castShadow receiveShadow />
        {/* jogger cuff */}
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.05, 0.048, 0.05, 20)} material={cl.legs} position={[0, -0.37, 0]} castShadow />
        <group position={[0, -0.42, 0]} rotation={[-l.an, 0, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={cyl(0.034, 0.036, 0.06, 16)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.01, 0]} castShadow />
          {c.feet === "sandal" ? (
            <>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.078, 0.042, 0.215, 0.02)} material={skin} position={[0, -0.05, 0.05]} castShadow receiveShadow />
              <mesh geometry={box(0.098, 0.016, 0.265, 0.007)} material={cl.sole} position={[0, -0.077, 0.052]} castShadow receiveShadow />
              {[1, -1].map((k) => (
                <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.009, 0.012, 0.11, 0.004)} material={cl.sole} position={[k * 0.03, -0.05, 0.1]} rotation={[0.25, k * 0.42, 0]} castShadow />
              ))}
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <mesh geometry={box(0.104, 0.034, 0.28, 0.014)} material={phys("soleShoe", { color: "#3b3c40", roughness: 0.8 })} position={[0, -0.068, 0.055]} castShadow receiveShadow />
              <mesh geometry={box(0.096, 0.08, 0.235, 0.035)} material={cl.sole} position={[0, -0.032, 0.045]} castShadow receiveShadow />
            </>
          )}
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

/** Hair clumps on the cap surface: local y = surface normal, local z = sweep direction. */
const hairClumps = (style: CharSpec["hairStyle"]) => {
  const out: { p: [number, number, number]; q: Quaternion; s: [number, number, number] }[] = [];
  const C = new Vector3(0, 0.016, -0.004);
  const r = mulberry32(style === "crop" ? 5 : 9);
  const put = (az: number, el: number, rad: number, sweep: number, sc: [number, number, number]) => {
    const n = new Vector3(Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el), Math.sin(el), Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el));
    const pos = C.clone().addScaledVector(n, rad);
    const q = new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), n);
    q.multiply(new Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(0, 1, 0), sweep));
    out.push({ p: [pos.x, pos.y, pos.z], q, s: sc });
  };
  if (style === "crop") {
    // soft fringe swept to his right, short textured top, tidy sides
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) put(-0.72 + i * 0.13 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.04, 0.56 + 0.05 * r(), 0.116, 2.7 + 0.08 * i + (r() - 0.5) * 0.3, [0.42, 0.2, 1.25 + 0.3 * r()]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) put(r() * Math.PI * 2, 0.75 + 0.6 * r(), 0.119, Math.PI + (r() - 0.5) * 1.2, [0.45 + 0.15 * r(), 0.2, 1.2 + 0.3 * r()]);
  } else {
    // longer, messier top with a side part
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) put(-0.8 + i * 0.14 + (r() - 0.5) * 0.05, 0.52 + 0.08 * r(), 0.12, 2.4 + 0.15 * i + 0.4 * r(), [0.5, 0.3, 1.5 + 0.4 * r()]);
    for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) put(r() * Math.PI * 2, 0.7 + 0.7 * r(), 0.124, Math.PI + (r() - 0.5) * 2.0, [0.55 + 0.2 * r(), 0.3, 1.4 + 0.5 * r()]);
  }
  return out;
};

const Head: React.FC<{ pose: Pose; c: CharSpec }> = ({ pose, c }) => {
  const f = pose.face;
  const skin = skinMat(c.skin);
  const hair = phys(`hair${c.hair}`, { color: c.hair, roughness: 0.62, sheen: 0.7, sheenColor: "#4a3a30", sheenRoughness: 0.45 });
  const eye = phys(`eye${c.key}`, { map: eyeTex(c.key, c.iris), roughness: 0.05, clearcoat: 1, clearcoatRoughness: 0.02 });
  const brow = phys(`brow${c.brow}`, { color: c.brow, roughness: 0.75 });
  const lash = phys("lash", { color: "#0b0806", roughness: 0.7 });
  const lip = phys(`lip${c.lip}`, { color: c.lip, roughness: 0.42, clearcoat: 0.2 });
  // upper lid edge sits ~30° above the eye centre when open (lid = 1), closes at 0, wide above 1
  const lidA = Math.min(Math.PI / 2, Math.max(-1.2, Math.PI / 2 - 2.09 * f.lid));
  const browY = 0.03 + 0.008 * f.browUp;
  const clumps = useMemo(() => hairClumps(c.hairStyle === "long" ? "messy" : c.hairStyle === "bald" ? "crop" : c.hairStyle), [c.hairStyle]);
  const open = Math.min(1, f.open + pose.talk);
  const showHair = !c.hijab && c.hairStyle !== "bald";
  const scarf = c.hijab ? phys(`hijab${c.hijab}`, { color: c.hijab, roughness: 0.85, sheen: 0.5, sheenColor: "#ffffff", sheenRoughness: 0.6, side: DoubleSide }) : null;
  const knit = c.cap ? phys(`cap${c.cap}`, { color: c.cap, roughness: 0.95, sheen: 0.6, sheenColor: "#ffffff", sheenRoughness: 0.7 }) : null;
  const beard = c.beard ? phys(`beard${c.beard}`, { color: c.beard, roughness: 0.9, sheen: 0.6, sheenColor: "#ffffff", sheenRoughness: 0.5 }) : null;
  const H = Math.PI / 2;
  const ER = 0.0178;
  return (
    <group position={[0, 0.09, 0.01]} scale={c.headScale}>
      <mesh geometry={headGeo(c.face)} material={skin} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <group key={`ear${s}`} position={[s * 0.1, -0.008, -0.008]} rotation={[0, s * 0.35, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={sphere(0.032, 20, 14)} material={skin} scale={[0.32, 0.95, 0.66]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={torus(0.019, 0.005, 8, 20, Math.PI * 1.4)} material={skin} position={[s * 0.004, 0.002, 0.003]} rotation={[0, s * Math.PI / 2, 1.2]} />
        </group>
      ))}
      {[1, -1].map((s) => (
        <group key={`eye${s}`} position={[s * 0.0375, 0.009, 0.0905]}>
          <mesh geometry={sphere(ER, 40, 24)} material={eye} rotation={[-f.eyeY, f.eyeX, 0]} />
          <group rotation={[lidA, 0, 0]}>
            <mesh geometry={sphere(ER + 0.0017, 32, 12, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI / 2)} material={skin} />
            <mesh geometry={torus(ER + 0.0017, 0.0011, 6, 28, Math.PI)} material={lash} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
          </group>
          <group rotation={[Math.PI + 0.98, 0, 0]}>
            <mesh geometry={sphere(ER + 0.0013, 32, 12, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI / 2)} material={skin} />
          </group>
          <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0045 + 0.0025 * c.face.brow, 0.026)} material={brow} position={[s * 0.003, browY, 0.011]} rotation={[0.25, s * 0.25, Math.PI / 2 + s * (0.06 - 0.38 * f.browIn + 0.1 * f.browUp)]} scale={[1, 1, 0.6]} />
        </group>
      ))}
      <group position={[0, -0.0655, 0.1028]}>
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.0125, 16, 10)} material={phys("mouthIn", { color: "#1a0a09", roughness: 0.95 })} position={[0, -0.002 - open * 0.002, -0.006]} scale={[1, 0.05 + open * 0.7, 0.45]} />
        <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0036, 0.026)} material={lip} position={[0, 0.0016, -0.0025]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2 + f.mouth * 0.06]} scale={[1, 1, 0.6]} />
        <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0042, 0.022)} material={lip} position={[0, -0.0048 - open * 0.006, -0.003]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} scale={[1, 1, 0.62]} />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.03, 0.0012, 0.004, 0.0005)} material={phys("mouthLine", { color: "#3a1c18", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, -0.0014 - open * 0.003, 0.0]} />
      </group>
      {/* hair */}
      {showHair ? <mesh geometry={sphere(0.122, 48, 24, Math.PI * 2, Math.PI * 0.56)} material={hair} position={[0, 0.014, -0.008]} rotation={[-0.44, 0, 0]} scale={[0.9, 1.04, 0.98]} castShadow /> : null}
      {showHair && c.hairStyle === "long" ? (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={shell(H + 0.85, Math.PI * 2 - 1.7, 0.2, 1.95)} material={phys(`hairL${c.hair}`, { color: c.hair, roughness: 0.62, sheen: 0.7, sheenColor: "#4a3a30", sheenRoughness: 0.45, side: DoubleSide })} position={[0, -0.035, -0.014]} scale={[0.132, 0.25, 0.132]} castShadow />
          {[1, -1].map((k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={capsule(0.022, 0.1)} material={hair} position={[k * 0.098, -0.045, 0.02]} rotation={[0.1, 0, k * 0.08]} scale={[0.7, 1, 0.9]} castShadow />)}
        </>
      ) : null}
      {beard ? (
        <>
          <mesh geometry={beardGeo(c.face)} material={beard} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={capsule(0.0042, 0.026)} material={beard} position={[0, -0.0585, 0.1085]} rotation={[0.25, 0, Math.PI / 2]} scale={[1, 1, 0.7]} />
        </>
      ) : null}
      {knit ? (
        <group position={[0, 0.018, -0.006]} rotation={[-0.15, 0, 0]}>
          <mesh geometry={shell(0, Math.PI * 2, 0, 1.3)} material={knit} scale={[0.128, 0.138, 0.131]} castShadow />
          <mesh geometry={torus(1, 0.13, 10, 40)} material={knit} position={[0, 0.138 * Math.cos(1.3), 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[0.128 * Math.sin(1.3), 0.131 * Math.sin(1.3), 0.13]} castShadow />
        </group>
      ) : null}
      {scarf ? <mesh geometry={hijabGeo(c.face)} material={scarf} castShadow /> : null}
      {pose.hold?.kind === "binoculars" && pose.hold.on > 0.6 ? <group position={[0, 0.009, 0.165]}><Binoculars /></group> : null}
      {c.glasses
        ? [1, -1].map((s) => (
            <group key={`gl${s}`}>
              <mesh geometry={torus(0.022, 0.0022, 6, 28)} material={phys("glassFrame", { color: "#3a2a1e", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[s * 0.038, 0.01, 0.112]} scale={[1.15, 0.9, 1]} />
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0018, 0.0018, 0.1, 6)} material={phys("glassFrame", { color: "#3a2a1e", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[s * 0.064, 0.012, 0.062]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
            </group>
          ))
        : null}
      {c.glasses ? <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0018, 0.0018, 0.026, 6)} material={phys("glassFrame", { color: "#3a2a1e", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0, 0.016, 0.114]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} /> : null}
      {(showHair && !knit ? clumps : []).map((k, i) => (
        <mesh key={i} geometry={sphere(0.036, 18, 12)} material={hair} position={k.p} quaternion={k.q} scale={k.s} castShadow />
      ))}
    </group>
  );
};

export const Character: React.FC<{ pose: Pose; spec: CharSpec; t: number; visible?: boolean; phoneScreen?: Material }> = ({ pose, spec: c, t, visible = true, phoneScreen }) => {
  const b = pose.breath * Math.sin((t / (pose.breath > 1.5 ? 1.4 : 3.6)) * Math.PI * 2);
  const skin = skinMat(c.skin);
  const cl = clothes(c);
  return (
    <group position={[pose.x, pose.y, pose.z]} rotation={[0, pose.yaw, 0]} scale={c.scale} visible={visible}>
      <group position={[0, 0.96 + pose.hipY, 0]} rotation={new Euler(pose.hips[0], pose.hips[1], -pose.hips[2], "YXZ")}>
        <mesh geometry={lathe("pelvis", PELVIS, 40)} material={cl.legs} scale={[1, 1, 0.68]} castShadow receiveShadow />
        <group position={[0, 0.1, 0]} rotation={new Euler(pose.spine[0], pose.spine[1], -pose.spine[2], "YXZ")}>
          <group position={[0, 0.2, 0]} rotation={new Euler(pose.chest[0] + 0.014 * b, pose.chest[1], -pose.chest[2], "YXZ")} scale={[1 + 0.007 * b, 1, 1 + 0.014 * b]}>
            <mesh geometry={lathe("torso", TORSO, 48)} material={cl.top} scale={[1, 1, 0.63]} castShadow receiveShadow />
            {c.top === "hoodie" ? (
              <>
                <mesh geometry={torus(0.085, 0.038, 12, 36, Math.PI * 1.55)} material={cl.top} position={[0, 0.262, -0.02]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, Math.PI * 0.225 + Math.PI]} scale={[1.08, 1, 1.15]} castShadow />
                <mesh geometry={sphere(0.115, 28, 18)} material={cl.top} position={[0, 0.17, -0.11]} scale={[0.95, 0.68, 0.32]} castShadow />
                <mesh geometry={box(0.24, 0.13, 0.024, 0.01)} material={cl.pocket} position={[0, -0.21, 0.116]} rotation={[-0.04, 0, 0]} castShadow />
                <mesh geometry={box(0.36, 0.045, 0.22, 0.02)} material={cl.top} position={[0, -0.335, 0]} scale={[1.05, 1, 0.98]} />
                {[1, -1].map((s) => (
                  <group key={s} position={[s * 0.034, 0.215, 0.118]} rotation={[0.12, 0, s * 0.06]}>
                    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0045, 0.0045, 0.14, 8)} material={cl.trim} position={[0, -0.07, 0]} castShadow />
                    <mesh geometry={cyl(0.0058, 0.0058, 0.02, 8)} material={phys("aglet", { color: "#b9b2a6", metalness: 0.7, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[0, -0.145, 0]} />
                  </group>
                ))}
              </>
            ) : c.top === "jacket" ? (
              <>
                <mesh geometry={lathe("torso", TORSO, 48)} material={cl.top} scale={[1.035, 1.01, 0.67]} castShadow receiveShadow />
                <mesh geometry={torus(0.078, 0.022, 10, 36)} material={cl.top} position={[0, 0.272, 0.0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2 - 0.25, 0, 0]} scale={[1.05, 0.9, 1.6]} castShadow />
                <mesh geometry={box(0.012, 0.5, 0.012, 0.004)} material={cl.trim} position={[0, -0.06, 0.142]} rotation={[-0.05, 0, 0]} />
                {[1, -1].map((k) => <mesh key={k} geometry={box(0.09, 0.07, 0.02, 0.008)} material={cl.top} position={[k * 0.1, -0.2, 0.13]} rotation={[-0.06, k * 0.25, 0]} castShadow />)}
                <mesh geometry={box(0.37, 0.04, 0.23, 0.02)} material={cl.trim} position={[0, -0.34, 0]} />
              </>
            ) : (
              <mesh geometry={torus(0.072, 0.012, 8, 30)} material={cl.trim} position={[0, 0.266, 0.006]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} scale={[1, 0.82, 1]} />
            )}
            {c.hijab ? (
              <mesh geometry={lathe("hijabDrape", [[0.0, 0.36], [0.07, 0.355], [0.085, 0.3], [0.15, 0.22], [0.215, 0.15], [0.225, 0.11], [0.0, 0.11]], 40)} material={phys(`hijab${c.hijab}`, { color: c.hijab, roughness: 0.85, sheen: 0.5, sheenColor: "#ffffff", sheenRoughness: 0.6, side: DoubleSide })} scale={[1, 1, 0.72]} castShadow />
            ) : null}
            <group position={[0, 0.27, -0.01]} rotation={new Euler(pose.neck[0], pose.neck[1], -pose.neck[2], "YXZ")}>
              <mesh geometry={cyl(0.052, 0.058, 0.12, 24)} material={skin} position={[0, 0.03, 0]} castShadow />
              <group position={[0, 0.09, 0.01]} rotation={new Euler(pose.head[0], pose.head[1], -pose.head[2], "YXZ")}>
                <Head pose={pose} c={c} />
              </group>
            </group>
            <ArmSide s={1} a={pose.armL} hand={pose.handL} c={c} t={t} tremble={pose.tremble} phone={pose.phone === 2 && phoneScreen ? phoneScreen : undefined} hold={pose.hold?.side === 1 ? pose.hold : null} />
            <ArmSide s={-1} a={pose.armR} hand={pose.handR} c={c} t={t + 3.1} tremble={pose.tremble} phone={pose.phone === 1 && phoneScreen ? phoneScreen : undefined} hold={pose.hold?.side === -1 ? pose.hold : null} />
          </group>
        </group>
        <LegSide s={1} l={pose.legL} c={c} />
        <LegSide s={-1} l={pose.legR} c={c} />
      </group>
    </group>
  );
};

==== 6139 project/src/cine/character/looks.ts

// colours / features per person (story.cast[].custom); identity then never changes between shots.

import type { CharSpec } from "./Character.tsx";

type Look = Omit<CharSpec, "key">;
